course.title: Microprocessors and Microcomputers
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value:
A microprocessor uses RAM chips of 1024x1 capacity. (10)   
i) How many chips are needed and how should their address lines be   
connected to provide a memory capacity of 1024 bytes?   
ii) How many chips are needed to provide a memory capacity of 16 Kbytes?   
Explain in words how the chips are to be connected to the address bus.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
